name: fix-md-module-naming
body: `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation` and `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` assert the checkout-independent fact that `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and `opencode-suite/agents/*.md` are scanned by the Markdown frontend and present as File nodes in the graph; a basename-derived module name stays out of that rule text. The Markdown module identity derives from the checkout or git-toplevel directory basename (it renders as `md.graph-first-prompt` in this worktree), a checkout-dependent value that `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity` and `requirements.requirement.frontend-rooting-from-repo-base` exclude. The graphed-versus-absent distinction stays unchanged.
